findings.what: isCauchySurface_of_isCauchySplitting_via_strictJplus_secondCountable (new) is the same proposition as the existing Causal.Causality.isCauchySurface_of_isLocallyCauchyTwoSided_secondCountable (Causal/CurvesFreeCauchy/CompactCauchy.lean:153, T-abs-curves-free-cauchy). They have the same hypotheses and the same conclusion; only the implicit binders {S₀} {ψ} sit at a different position, so the two are not syntactically equal but each is the other's instance. The reason is that the original ..._via_strictJplus is itself a re-proof (twin) of Causal.Causality.isCauchySurface_of_isLocallyCauchyTwoSided. So kb/0260's diff-first missed one existing form. The REPORT's claim that the other conclusion matches, 'e.g. Causal.CurvesFreeCauchy.CompactCauchy's splitting form', 'have different hypothesis sets' is false for this pair, and the bthm:cauclo note calls this form a 'further' curve-free form. The statement itself is correct: exactly the original less hext plus SC.
findings.fix: Disclose the twin. Say so in Bare.lean's docstring for the theorem and in SCOPE, and in the REPORT (7 exact forms already existed, plus 1 existing twin up to implicit-binder order). Alternatively drop the new form and cite the existing one. Keeping it beside the original is defensible under OQ-98, since the original is itself a twin, but it must be said.

findings.what: 'The two-sided form isCauchySurface_of_isLocallyCauchyTwoSided_of_isOpen_Jplus_secondCountable is subsumed by the lemma of record' gets the direction wrong. The lemma of record isCauchySurface_of_isLocallyCauchy_of_causallyOpen needs C.CausallyOpen, that is J^±_U(V) open for every U ⊇ V (Causal/Properties.lean:130). The two-sided form needs only J^±_M(V) open (U = M). So the lemma of record does not imply the two-sided form. The two-sided form is subsumed by Causal.Causality.isCauchySurface_of_isLocallyCauchy_of_isOpen_Jplus_of_secondCountable (Causal/LemmaKSCLocal.lean:94), which needs only the U = M halves and is itself more general than the lemma of record.
findings.fix: Correct the note before the keeper reads it: the two-sided form is subsumed by isCauchySurface_of_isLocallyCauchy_of_isOpen_Jplus_of_secondCountable (LemmaKSCLocal). That form, not the lemma of record, is the candidate if the keeper wants Lemma K at causally_open_future/past at U = M only.
